clues: This town is the chief town of West Java in Indonesia. It sits on high land in the west of Java, south east of Jakarta.
High land gives this city cool air for this part of the world. It is one of the coolest capitals in all of Indonesia.
Dutch rulers gave it a town government in 1906. It soon grew into a fine resort town for Europeans.
The Dutch once planned to move their capital to this city. A ring of volcanic peaks stood round it like a shield.
Dutch planters set up tea farms in the hills here long ago. They planted tea all around the mountain slopes.
